BLAZING VIOLET orchid blossoms in full three-dimensional bloom, VIVID GOLD leaves and curling tendrils filling every remaining gap with real depth and texture, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours.
